## Featured connection {#featured .mm-section-title}

::: {.mm-feature}
<p class="mm-type">Research synthesis · Featured idea</p>

## What does a healthy mussel look like?

Mytilus physiology connects molecular responses to an organism's ability to survive, grow, reproduce, and respond to environmental change. This is a place to trace those connections, without assuming that any single biomarker tells the whole story.

**What we know:** Physiological endpoints capture different aspects of an organism's response.

**Why it matters:** Translating cellular changes into ecological meaning requires attention to context, timescale, and organism-level function.

**What I'm connecting it to:** My research on biomarker responses, DNA methylation, and the development of more integrative measures of mussel health.

<p class="mm-meta">Working feature — replace or link to a full post when ready.</p>
:::
